78-30-01A.t: ENG 1(2) REV PRESSURIZED alert not displayed after deactivation
78-30-01A.txt:

            3) The ENG 1(2) REV UNLOCKED alert and the ENG 1(2) REV PRESSURIZED alert

               deactivation, and

78-30-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      For T/O and Landing performance determination, determine the associated Flight Manual
      performance penalties with the OCTOPUS program.
      Note:     In the Airbus EFB PERF applications(FlySmart+):
                ‐ If one engine reverser is inoperative, this correspond to the MEL item “THRUST
                   REVERSERS CREDIT ONE REVERSER INOPERATIVE"
                ‐ If both engine reversers are inoperative, this correspond to the MEL item “THRUST
                   REVERSERS CREDIT ALL REVERSERS INOPERATIVE".
      If not available, contact dispatcher for takeoff and landing performance data.
   FLIGHT CREW
      Contact dispatcher for flight release update and “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS”
      confirmation.
   DURING COCKPIT PREPARATION
       After application of the maintenance procedure
        and
        When the FADEC have power:
        Check that the ENG (AFFECTED SIDE) REV INHIBITED alert is displayed on the EWD.
   FOR TAKEOFF
      During the takeoff briefing, the flight crew must review:
      ‐ The status of the thrust reversers, and
      ‐ The use of the thrust reversers
   REJECTED TAKEOFF
      Ensure that both engine thrust levers are set to IDLE detent, then:
       If one thrust reverser is inoperative:
         Use both thrust levers when applying reverse thrust.
       If both thrust reversers are inoperative:
        Do not move the thrust levers to reverse.






  DURING APPROACH
     During the approach briefing, the flight crew must review:
     ‐ The status of the thrust reversers, and
     ‐ The use of the thrust reversers
  FOR LANDING
     Before the touchdown, ensure that both engine thrust levers are set to IDLE detent for the flare.
      After touchdown, if one thrust reverser is inoperative:
         Use both thrust levers when applying reverse thrust.
          For automatic roll-out with one thrust reverser inoperative, Refer to AFM/LIM-22-FGS CAT II /
          CAT III Operations.
      After touchdown, if both thrust reversers are inoperative:
       Do not move the thrust levers to reverse.


                                               Thrust Reverser (ENG 1(2) REV PRESSURIZED
78-30-01A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
이륙 및 착륙 성능 산출 시, 해당 Flight Manual 성능 패널티(penalty)를 OCTOPUS 프로그램으로 산출한다.
Note: Airbus EFB PERF 애플리케이션(FlySmart+)에서:
‐ 한쪽 엔진 reverser가 작동 불능이면 MEL item "THRUST REVERSERS CREDIT ONE REVERSER INOPERATIVE"에 해당한다.
‐ 양쪽 엔진 reverser가 모두 작동 불능이면 MEL item "THRUST REVERSERS CREDIT ALL REVERSERS INOPERATIVE"에 해당한다.
사용할 수 없으면 이륙·착륙 성능 데이터는 dispatcher(운항관리사)에게 연락해 받는다.
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
Flight release 갱신과 "FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS" 확인을 위해 dispatcher(운항관리사)에게 연락한다.
DURING COCKPIT PREPARATION (조종실 준비 중)
정비 절차를 적용한 후
그리고
FADEC에 전원이 들어와 있을 때:
EWD에 ENG (AFFECTED SIDE, 해당 측) REV INHIBITED alert가 표시되는지 확인한다.
FOR TAKEOFF (이륙)
이륙 브리핑 시 운항승무원은 다음을 검토해야 한다:
‐ thrust reverser 상태, 그리고
‐ thrust reverser 사용 방법
REJECTED TAKEOFF (이륙 중단)
양쪽 엔진 thrust lever가 IDLE detent에 있는지 확인한 뒤:
thrust reverser 하나가 작동 불능이면:
역추력(reverse thrust) 적용 시 양쪽 thrust lever를 모두 사용한다.
thrust reverser 둘 다 작동 불능이면:
thrust lever를 reverse로 움직이지 않는다.
DURING APPROACH (접근 중)
접근 브리핑 시 운항승무원은 다음을 검토해야 한다:
‐ thrust reverser 상태, 그리고
‐ thrust reverser 사용 방법
FOR LANDING (착륙)
접지(touchdown) 전, flare를 위해 양쪽 엔진 thrust lever가 IDLE detent에 있는지 확인한다.
접지 후, thrust reverser 하나가 작동 불능이면:
역추력 적용 시 양쪽 thrust lever를 모두 사용한다.
thrust reverser 하나가 작동 불능인 상태의 automatic roll-out(자동 활주)에 대해서는 AFM/LIM-22-FGS CAT II / CAT III Operations 참조.
접지 후, thrust reverser 둘 다 작동 불능이면:
thrust lever를 reverse로 움직이지 않는다.
